sections.text: Varstern 6037 gained 11.80 to reach 42.36, moving from 932nd to 40th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The move extends the team's rise after its earlier jump into the top 100; the ARC-2 gold cutoff is 58.06 at 15th.
